question: For my February 2013 activity report: how many SME customers actually purchased gas in February 2013? Please give me just a single whole number - the count of SME customers who consumed gas during the calendar month of February 2013 (Feb 1-28, 2013).
evidence: By "gas" I mean gasoline (motor fuel) purchases, not natural gas.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.CustomerID) AS sme_gas_customers FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date = '201302' AND T2.Consumption > 0

expected.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.CustomerID) AS sme_gas_customers FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date = '201302' AND T2.Consumption > 0
expected.evidence: By "gas" I mean gasoline (motor fuel) purchases, not natural gas.
